en: Color postcard showing a large carved wooden gate leading into a traditional wooden homestead, with shingled roofs and floral carvings, typical of Romanian village architecture. Two visitors stand under the porch. Bright blue sky and greenery surround the scene. The back identifies the site in multiple languages and bears the Romanian national tourism office imprint.
